capabilities: generate an index note in each folder listing its files and subfolders
update index files automatically on file creation, deletion and moves
tag index notes with configurable YAML meta tags
customize index content via Templater templates and sections
include or exclude specific folders and subfolders from indexing
extras: The README carries a data-loss disclaimer and warns that manually created folder notes may be overwritten unless a Templater template is set up.
motivation: The author wanted to relieve users of the tedious work of maintaining folder-based MOCs and manually updating parent categories when files move.
problem: Building Maps of Content and folder indexes by hand is tedious, and moving files between folders forces manual relinking of their parent categories.

relations.evidence: I also use the Folder Note plugin, just for the fact that it hides files in folders
The template can be managed by the Templater plugin.

summary: Folder-index plugin that maintains an index note in every folder, auto-updating it when notes are created, deleted or moved.
